title: John drives the new Roadster through the Earth
notes: Source of truth for every spoken word. 'text' is spoken AND shown as subtitles (spelled exactly like this). 'tts_text' (optional) is a respelling only for the offline voice, with the same words in the same order. 'eleven_v3_text' adds optional ElevenLabs v3 audio tags; tags are never shown in subtitles.

narrator.description: calm, friendly, a little playful, quick pace, neutral accent
narrator.elevenlabs_voice_name: Elena Wren - Friendly, warm and kind, with neutral accent
narrator.elevenlabs_fallback_voice_name: Sarah (premade), used only if Elena Wren is not in the account

john.description: friendly young guy; dizzy and polite

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If you put John in Elon Musk's new Roadster and dig straight down, he can drive to the other side of the Earth. Sort of.
lines.eleven_v3_text: If you put John in Elon Musk's new Roadster and dig straight down, he can drive to the other side of the Earth. [playfully] Sort of.
lines.tts_text: If you put John in Ee-lon Musk's new Roadster and dig straight down, he can drive to the other side of the Earth. Sort of.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the tires just spin in the dirt. So you add a giant drill to the front.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the tunnel caves in behind him. So the car builds concrete rings as it goes, like a real tunnel machine.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But deep down, the rock is hotter than an oven. So you add a heat shield and ice-cold air.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the Earth's core is as hot as the surface of the Sun. So John hits the SpaceX thrusters and zooms through in under a second.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But most of the other side is ocean. So he aims very carefully for a beach.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Congratulations, John drove through the whole Earth.
lines.eleven_v3_text: [warmly] Congratulations, John drove through the whole Earth.

lines.speaker: john
lines.text: Hi... is there a charger around here?
lines.eleven_v3_text: [dazed] Hi... [politely] is there a charger around here?

local_parts.text: is there a charger around here?
